# E0234: a minor version's pattern constraints cannot be shown to cover its predecessor's

Pattern constraints decide what a struct accepts for field names it does not
declare. The checker compares one pattern per side; several on each side are
compared only for identity, so a change among them cannot be decided.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				m: {[=~"^a"]: int, [=~"^b"]: string}
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				m: {[=~"^a"]: int, [=~"^b"]: number}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0234]: schema 0.1 is not backward compatible with 0.0 at m in schema 0.1
  --> lineage.cue:11:5
   |
11 |                 m: {[=~"^a"]: int, [=~"^b"]: number}
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: m in schema 0.1 has several pattern constraints, [=~"^a"], [=~"^b"] in the prior schema and [=~"^a"], [=~"^b"] in the new one, which the checker compares only for identity
   = note: schema 0.1 is declared as a minor version of 0.0, so every instance of schema 0.0 must be an instance of it (compatibility rule unknown-patterns)
   = help: change the schema so the checker can decide, or make this version 1.0
```
